tables.title: Game sides: Book A vs prediction markets vs other books
tables.note: Home win probability (vig removed). Gap = Book A minus the Exchange A/Exchange B average. A gap over 6 points means the exchanges see the game differently; check news, then shop the side the markets favor.

tables.note: Exchange A mid-price (between bid and ask) as an implied probability; markets with no quotes or a spread over 12¢ are skipped. 'disagree' = 10+ points apart: either an edge or something our model is missing.
